name: Our Little World
subtitle: Private baby book for family
privacyPolicyText: Our Little World is a private baby book for families. The app may collect account information such as the email address used for one-time-code sign-in; family profile information you add; photos, photo metadata, notes, milestones, letters, and other memories you choose to save; and device permission status for Photos, Camera, or Microphone. This information is used to provide the private family timeline, library, milestones, prompts, letters, and invite features. We do not sell personal information and do not use a public social feed, likes, or advertising algorithm. Photos and memories are intended for your private family space. For support or privacy requests, contact jesse.krim@gmail.com.
